identity.name: RetroVMS Mini
identity.description: Vehicle control module with 24 inputs, 12 outputs, and CAN bus

status_led.description: RGB status LED. from lib.sys.status_led import status_led, then status_led.set_color((r, g, b)), set_flashing(color), set_throbbing(color), off(), or release() to give it back

buzzer.description: Magnetic buzzer on a transistor. from lib.sys import buzzer, then buzzer.beep(ms) returns at once and stops by itself, so it's safe in a loop. A tone pulls imu.read() about 400 mg off until shortly after it stops, so beep() ignores calls until then. Don't hold its pin high, because DC then runs through the coil. A MicroMod processor in the socket shares this line on G2

tic12400_inputs.description: 24-channel digital input IC. No MicroPython driver yet

drv8912_outputs.description: 12-channel half-bridge output driver. No MicroPython driver yet

mcp2515_can1.description: CAN1 controller, whose RX0BF and RX1BF pins switch CAN0 and CAN1 termination. No MicroPython driver yet

rtc.description: Real-time clock holding UTC, kept going by capacitors while the board is off. The firmware sets the system clock from it at boot and sets it, to the second, whenever NTP syncs, so time.time() already uses it. To read the chip, from lib.sys import bus and from lib.sys.drivers.rx8111 import RX8111, then RX8111(bus.get_i2c("i2c0"), 0x32).read() gives (y, m, d, h, min, s), or None if it isn't valid

imu.description: 3-axis accelerometer. from lib.sys import imu, then imu.read() gives x, y and z in milli-g, and wakes it the first time. At rest, gravity reads about 1000 mg on the axis facing down, and tilting moves it between the axes, so to notice a tilt, compare with a reading taken at rest. INT1 on int1_pin is shared with the MicroMod socket's I2C_INT

micromod.description: Takes an STM32F405 module, whose ROM bootloader is a UART on these pins, shared with I2C. Install the micromod app to program it

wwan.description: Cellular modem socket on USB, powered at boot. import usbmodem, then usbmodem.connected(), and usbmodem.send_at("AT") returns its reply, from about 15 s after power. OSError 259 or 263 means it isn't ready
